adopted.UnionFindW: reset preserves parent clear+resize; for nothrow copy/assignment/destruction T, resize weights and fill only min(old_size,new_size) retained weights; new suffix initialized once. Other T preserves clear+copy path; all reservations/zero construction before mutation.
adopted.RollbackWeightedUnionFind: try_diff short-circuits when two nonroot vertices share immediate parent; same shortcut in GCC consistent. Checked signed standard two-limb accumulator excludes both new shortcuts; Clang consistent uses root accumulation. No fields/history/ownership changes.

proofs.reset: retained prefix already live and noexcept assignment; newly grown suffix receives noexcept zero copy once. Capacity reservation and zero construction retain original failure-state guarantee. Shrink destroys only removed elements with noexcept destructor.
proofs.difference: potential(y)-potential(x)=edge(y)-edge(x) for common immediate parent, using commutative additive group. Signed subtraction uses existing mandatory checked arithmetic; try_diff overflow continues into existing wide path, consistent overflow cannot equal representable w and returns false. Both vertices nonroot, so stale root weights are never read.
proofs.configuration: Compile-time direct_difference excludes checked signed two-limb configurations; existing body is byte identical there. GCC-only consistent avoids reproduced Clang Ring balanced +8.4%. No new SIMD or runtime CPU selection.

performance.metric: accepted operation-only strict/reset/focus/wide uses process CPU time via std::clock; fixed online main uses child user+system CPU time; CPU4 pinned, benchmark/compile serialized lock. Older steady_clock screening is exploratory only.

validation.counts: UnionFindW reference 28124703, rollback reference 3119573, cpp_int BFS 2012513, extra shared-parent/Big/reset 588870 per respective run; exception/lifetime/mutable-first suites also PASS
validation.configurations: GCC/Clang checked/skip native128/forced standard; GCC ASan+UBSan native/standard; final rollback 42 configurations, final UnionFindW included in previous 60.

rejected.u_query_shortcuts: same-parent normalized/equal/root-only shortcut variants improve star queries but GCC mixed workloads +5 to17% (some both variants more); root-only preserves compression but still slower mixed. No query edits adopted.
rejected.u_singleton_merge: extra singleton branch regresses other large constraints/builds; rejected.
rejected.u_bulk_reset: resize+fill whole vector reinitializes growing suffix; fresh/clear/grow large int64/Ring up to ~1.9x. Replaced by prefix-only zero assignment.
rejected.r_parent_normalization: normalizing root IDs and copying generic wx/wy bloats default GCC Mint try_diff past inlining threshold; short direct-child-only version adopted.
rejected.r_integer_only: weaker improvement than short generic version; no need arbitrary type restriction.
rejected.r_split_slow_helper: star up to ~40% shorter but half/disconnected/deep +~9 to13%; rejected.
rejected.r_clang_consistent: Ring balanced +8.4% reproduced with 11 repeats; baseline compiler path retained.
rejected.r_standard_signed: forced standard two-limb overflow/cancellation workload +~5 to7%; baseline compiler path retained and byte identity checked.

limits: No universal fastest claim or online submission performed. Existing submissions retain historical source meaning.
Default/native GCC15.2 P-Core CPU4 only, plus Clang checks; E-Core not targeted.
Some active GCC int64 deep conditions differ ~2 to3%; target star query improvements ~15 to30%, reset Mint ~38% large.
Initial multiplexed-TU/steady-wall screening contains code-layout/scheduling noise and is not final adoption evidence.
